title: Extract Images from PowerPoint – Save PPTX Media, No Upload
description: Save every picture, video and audio file stored in a PowerPoint presentation at original quality, in one ZIP, right in your browser. No upload.
heading: Extract images and media from PowerPoint
subtitle: Save every picture, video and audio file inside a PowerPoint presentation at its original quality; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Get the images out of a PPTX without PowerPoint: choose a presentation and download every picture, video and audio file stored in it, as they were put in. Nothing is re-compressed, so photos keep their full resolution. Several files come in one ZIP; a single file is saved directly. Works with .pptx, .ppsx, .potx and .pptm files. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Original quality
features.text: Files are saved as they are stored in the presentation, never re-compressed.

features.title: Pictures, video and audio
features.text: Every picture, video and audio file in the presentation, all at once.

stepsTitle: How to extract images from PowerPoint

steps.title: Choose your presentation
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .pptx, .ppsx, .potx or .pptm file on the page.

steps.title: Let it collect the media
steps.text: Every picture, video and audio file stored in the presentation is gathered.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Several files come in one ZIP; a single file is saved directly.

handles: Pictures, saved in the format and size stored in the file.
Video and audio files embedded in the presentation.
Result: one ZIP, or the file itself when there is only one.
limits: Videos linked from the web are not stored in the file, so they can't be saved.
Shapes, charts and SmartArt are drawings, not pictures, so they are not included.
Old .ppt files can't be read; save them as .pptx first.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I get all the pictures out of a PowerPoint?
faq.answer: Pictures in a presentation can be saved one at a time in PowerPoint by right-clicking a picture and choosing Save as Picture. This page saves all of them at once: choose the file and download every picture, video and audio file at original quality, without uploading.

faq.question: Are the pictures re-compressed?
faq.answer: No. Each file is saved exactly as it is stored in the presentation, so photos keep their resolution and quality.

faq.question: Why is my video missing?
faq.answer: A video linked from the web is not stored in the presentation, only its address, so there is no file to save. Videos inserted from your device are included.

faq.question: Why are charts and SmartArt not included?
faq.answer: They are drawings made of shapes, not picture files. To keep them as images, save the slides with PowerPoint to JPG.

faq.question: Do the photos still carry camera or location data?
faq.answer: They can: pictures are saved as they were stored, with any camera or location details still in them. Remove those with Remove image metadata, also in your browser.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
